import paramiko
ssh = paramiko.SSHClient()
ssh.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())

print('Restarting openWakeWord...')
stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command('sudo docker restart app_core_openwakeword')

print('Restarting satellite...')
stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command('sudo docker restart wyoming-wyze-camera')

import time
time.sleep(5)

# Now check if HA sees the satellite

print('=== SATELLITE LOGS after restart ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command('sudo docker logs --tail 10 wyoming-wyze-camera 2>&1')
print(stdout.read().decode())

print('=== OWW LOGS after restart ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = ssh.exec_command('sudo docker logs --tail 10 app_core_openwakeword 2>&1')
print(stdout.read().decode())

ssh.close()
